transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in today. What brings you here and what would you like to discuss during our session?

I guess what brings me in is... I’ve just stopped wanting to do the things that normally keep me going. Like going out for salsa nights, church gatherings, cooking for the neighbors—things I used to look forward to. Even walking into my shop just to enjoy the smell of the wood doesn’t really do anything for me right now.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
Yes. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. It’s like all the color has gone out of the house, and I’m just trying not to break down in front of my wife.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to focus, make decisions, or think clearly lately?

Yes. It’s been hard to think straight. I’ll be looking at blueprints I’ve read my whole life, and it’s like the lines just blur together in my head. I end up asking the younger guys to repeat things that I should understand right away. It’s frustrating.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like salsa nights, church gatherings, or cooking for your neighbors?

Yes. That’s really one of the main reasons I came in. I just don’t feel like doing any of those things anymore—salsa nights, church, cooking for people. Even going into my shop, which usually makes me feel good, doesn’t do much for me now.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping track of my weight, and I can’t say I’ve noticed a clear change in my appetite.
Have you had any trouble sleeping lately, such as difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up too early?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really been paying close attention to my sleep, so I can’t say for sure if it’s changed.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough, or been blaming yourself for things you wouldn’t normally feel guilty about?

Yes. I keep going over my wife’s appointments and every change in her health, thinking I should’ve noticed something sooner. I tell myself a better husband would’ve protected her somehow, even though I don’t know what I could’ve done.
Have you noticed that you feel more tired or that you’ve lost your energy lately, even when you haven’t done anything physically or mentally exhausting?

Yes. I feel worn out even when I haven’t really done anything. I can sit down for a while, or even spend the whole night in bed, and my body still feels like I’ve been framing a roof all day. Little things, like loading tools into the truck, feel like too much sometimes.
Have you had any thoughts about death or dying, or felt like you just don’t want to go on anymore?

Yes… I have had thoughts like that. Not that I’ve made some plan, but sometimes I think it might be easier if I just didn’t wake up. And I catch myself thinking my family might be better off without me. That scares me to even say.
How long have you been feeling this way? Was there a specific time or event when you first noticed these feelings starting?
It’s been about two months now. I think it really started when my wife’s health suddenly got worse and our whole routine changed. Since then, I just haven’t felt like myself.
Have these feelings of depression occurred in response to the worsening of your wife’s health, or do they seem to be happening more independently of that situation?
It feels mostly tied to my wife’s health getting worse. That’s when everything changed at home, and since then—about two months now—my mood and the way I’ve been acting just haven’t been the same.

Have you ever felt this way before, with a period of depression lasting several weeks or more, and if so, was there ever a time when you were feeling better for at least a couple of months before this current episode started?

Yeah… I’ve had low periods before, but this one has really been dragging on. It feels like it’s been about six months now, not just a bad week or normal stress. I can’t really point to a time recently where I felt better for a couple months before it started.
Before this current period, have you had any other episodes of depression that lasted for several weeks or more, and if so, how many and when were they?
I’m not really sure how many, honestly. I’ve had times before where I felt down for a while, but I can’t pin down exact episodes or dates. This current one is the clearest in my mind.
Between the times you felt down before, were there at least two separate periods where you felt this way, each lasting several weeks or more?
I’m not sure I can say that. I know I’ve had stretches where I was down, but I can’t clearly separate them into two different periods that lasted weeks. It’s kind of blurry before this current one.
